info.title: Trading Co-Pilot API
info.description: The single-operator futures trading co-pilot BFF (R-10). Generated from the live minimal-API routes (gh#604) — the source of truth the README links to, replacing the hand-kept table.

post.summary: Authenticate with email + password; returns a JWT bearer token.

get.summary: The currently authenticated user.

post.summary: Issue an invitation to create an account (primary operator only).
Redeem an invitation token to create an account; returns a JWT.
Register a firm the operator trades with.

get.summary: List the operator's registered firms.

put.summary: Declare what each account stage means at a firm.

List the accounts discovered through a connection.

put.summary: Rotates which credential key a connection names (gh#210, R-17, ADR-0015).

200.description: The updated connection, or a refusal.

delete.summary: Deactivates a connection and cascades to its accounts — a soft delete (gh#210, R-17, R-20).

200.description: Ok on deactivation (idempotent), or 404 when it is not the operator's.

put.summary: Set a manual stage override on an account.

delete.summary: Clear the manual stage override on an account.

put.summary: Declare the account's risk rules (validated whole; refused on any violation).

get.summary: The account's declared risk profile, if any.
Today's remaining daily-loss budget and target progress, readable without a send (gh#587).

post.summary: Author a standing deterministic trigger.

get.summary: List the operator's triggers.
Get a trigger by id.

post.summary: Confirm a trigger that requires operator confirmation.
Create a ticker↔instrument relevance map.

get.summary: List the ticker↔instrument maps.

post.summary: Create a relevance topic.

get.summary: List relevance topics.
Get a relevance topic by id.
The personalized feed: recent news re-ranked by the operator's decayed salience profile.

put.summary: Stars or mutes a news item — an upsert: re-rating replaces, so an item carries at most one feedback.

delete.summary: Un-stars / un-mutes an item — the personalization round-trips, so its salience returns to base.

get.summary: Lists an account's suggestions, newest first. Defaults to the actionable set (SuggestionState.Active) — a decision surface should not open on rows that can no longer be acted on; the rest stay reachable by explicit filter and by id.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The account whose suggestions to list.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The lifecycle state to filter to; omitted means active only.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size; clamped to the configured maximum.

get.summary: Reads one suggestion by id, in any state — an expired or superseded row stays readable, because the journal outlives the decision window.

200.description: The suggestion, or 404 when it does not exist or belongs to another operator.

post.summary: Records a neutral pass on a suggestion (gh#547, R-4/R-8): `POST /suggestions/{id}/pass`. A pass touches no order, gate or venue — it writes one SuggestionDisposition so the R-9 learning loop has the operator's decline to read.
post.description: A pass on an already stale or expired suggestion is still accepted — the operator's note is worth keeping, and lifecycle state is the clock's, not the disposition's (gh#539). One disposition per suggestion: a second conflicts (409) rather than overwriting, because the journal records the decision, not the latest edit.

200.description: The recorded disposition, 404 when the suggestion is not the caller's, or 409 when already disposed.

post.summary: Arm an editable, unsent order ticket from a suggestion.
Send an order through the full risk gate (direct send).

get.summary: Read the account's resting working orders from venue truth.

post.summary: Arm (stage) an order: evaluate the risk gate without transmitting.
Opt-in fast path: send an order as-is.
Create a conditional (triggered) order.

delete.summary: Cancel a staged or working order.

post.summary: Take a staged order: re-validate everything fresh, then transmit.
Reconcile a stranded (mid-take) order against venue truth: adopt if live, release if flat.

patch.summary: Modifies a working order in place (gh#259/gh#267/gh#278/gh#292, ADR-0007) — the venue-facing sibling of the cancel. Unlike a cancel (risk-reducing, gate-exempt), a modify can add risk (a likelier-to-fill entry, a wider stop, a larger size), so it runs the full send ladder and is re-gated before the venue is touched: the gate must approve the new terms, or nothing is transmitted (enforcement below the model). It can move the entry, re-stage the hidden working stop, and/or resize the order; the safety stop is held invariant on every path. A working-stop-only move with no size change re-stages locally (no venue call).

post.summary: Reconcile a stranded (mid-fire) conditional against venue truth: adopt if live, release if flat.
Engage the kill switch (hold-to-confirm): stop new orders, cancel working orders, flatten or halt.

get.summary: The current kill-switch state.

post.summary: Disengage the kill switch, re-enabling outbound orders.

get.summary: Reconcile and read the account's open positions against venue truth.
OHLCV bars for a venue + instrument + resolution over a bounded time window (ascending).
A stored indicator series (e.g. atr, rsi) over a bounded time window — never recomputed (R-22).
Active price levels for a venue + instrument across the requested timeframes.

token.description: The invite token from the invitation.

AcceptInviteRequest.description: A request to accept an invitation and create the account.

AccountStage.description: Where an account sits in a firm's programme. Read from what the venue reports — for ProjectX that means the account name, which really does encode size, stage, and status.

ConditionalCrossDirection.description: Which way price must cross the trigger for a conditional order to fire (ADR-0007, gh#176). A refusable zero: ConditionalCrossDirection.Unknown is the unset value and never fires — a direction must be declared, or the order would rest forever.

ConsistencyEnforcement.description: How the gate treats a breached consistency target (gh#380).

order.description: The entry proposal to hold and fire when the trigger crosses.

triggerPrice.description: The price at which the order fires.

triggerDirection.description: Which way price must cross the trigger to fire (RisesTo / FallsTo).

cancelDrift.description: The optional cancel band — the stale-side price past which the setup is abandoned.

expiresAt.description: The optional validity deadline; past it, a still-pending order cancels.

CreateConditionalOrderRequest.description: The request to create a synthetic conditional entry order (gh#176, ADR-0007) — the "send when conditions met" mode. The proposal rides an ordinary SendOrderRequest; the conditional part is the trigger and its cancel-if / expiry.

firmId.description: The firm this login belongs to.

platform.description: The platform key (e.g. `projectx`). Only wired adapters are accepted.

credentialKey.description: The non-secret env-entry name the credentials live under.

CreateConnectionRequest.description: The request to register a firm login (ADR-0016: one per firm × platform).

CreateFirmRequest.description: The request to register a firm the operator trades with.

period.description: The indicator period; must be positive.

resolutionMinutes.description: The bar size in minutes; must be positive.

comparison.description: Below or Above; Unknown is refused.

route.description: Where a fire routes; Mechanical or AgentReview.

hysteresis.description: The optional re-arm dead-band; null means none, and it must be positive when set.

severity.description: How loudly the alert arrives; defaults to NotificationSeverity.Notify.

accountId.description: The account a fired agent-review suggestion issues against — required for AgentReview (owned + mode declared), refused for Mechanical. Null otherwise.

size.description: The contract size a fired agent-review suggestion issues at — required and positive for AgentReview, refused for Mechanical. The operator's size, never the model's.

CreateTriggerRequest.description: The body of a create-trigger request (gh#385). Only the indicator-threshold kind is authored today.

conventions.description: The declarations. Each stage may appear at most once, and none may be Unknown.

DeclareConventionsRequest.description: The request to declare a firm's full set of stage conventions (replaces any existing).

dailyLossLimit.description: The hard daily loss limit; null when the account has none.

accountProfitTarget.description: The account's profit target (evaluation accounts); null otherwise.

startingBalance.description: The account's declared starting balance — where the floor starts from. Positive.

floorSource.description: Whether the loss floor is firm-imposed or self-imposed.

trailingMode.description: How the drawdown floor trails — end-of-day or intraday.

trailingAmount.description: The trailing distance below the equity high-water mark. Positive.

locksAt.description: The ceiling the floor stops trailing at, if any.

perTradeRiskFraction.description: Risk per trade as a fraction of headroom to the floor — in (0, 1].

maxDrawdownPerTrade.description: The per-trade hard loss cap. Positive.

dailyProfitTarget.description: The personal daily profit target; null means none.

stopForDayAtProfitTarget.description: Whether reaching the daily target stops trading for the day.

sizingBasis.description: Whether sizing uses the working stop or the safety stop.

maxContractsPerOrder.description: The manual per-order contract cap; 0 means uncapped.

maxBestDayFraction.description: The consistency target — best day ÷ total net profit, in (0, 1]; null means none.

consistencyEnforcement.description: Whether breaching that target refuses the order or only warns (gh#380); only consulted when a target is set.

defaultEntryAction.description: Which entry action is primary on the Approve split button (R-11, gh#218). Defaults to `ApproveAndArm` (review-first); `SendAsIs` is practice-only and requires ConfirmSendAsIsDefault.

confirmSendAsIsDefault.description: The explicit confirmation required to default to `SendAsIs` — a request that sets `SendAsIs` without it is refused 422 (the kill switch's hold-to-confirm shape).

DeclareRiskProfileRequest.description:
The request to declare an account's risk rules (R-5, gh#10) — the complete declaration; a redeclaration
replaces the whole profile.

DefaultEntryAction.description: Which entry action is the operator's default — the primary half of the Approve split button (R-11, ADR-0007, gh#218).

mode.description: Flatten all open positions (default) or halt only (leave them on native safety stops).

confirmed.description: The hold-to-confirm gesture — must be `true` to engage.

reason.description: The operator's reason, optional, journaled with the action.

EngageKillSwitchRequest.description: A request to engage the kill switch (gh#189).

FirmType.description: What kind of account provider a Firm is. A prop firm runs staged programmes (evaluation → funded); a brokerage does not — its accounts are simply live or paper. The distinction matters because stage conventions (gh#60) apply to prop firms only (gh#76).

FloorSource.description:
Where the loss floor comes from. The risk-budget dynamic is identical either way — only the origin and the
consequence of a breach differ (R-5).

IndicatorComparison.description: How an indicator value is compared to a threshold in a trigger condition (R-4 / R-7, ADR-0008).

IssueInvitationRequest.description: A request to issue an onboarding invitation.

KillSwitchMode.description: What the kill switch does to open positions when engaged (ADR-0007, R-11, gh#189).

entryPrice.description:
The new entry price, or `null` to leave it. When present, the entry reprices at the venue and
re-gates (gh#259); decimal? ModifyWorkingOrderRequest.ReferencePrice is then required.

workingStopPrice.description: The new hidden working-stop price, or `null` to leave it (gh#267). A hidden stop is a promotion target, not a venue order, so re-staging it alone is a local write — no venue call. It re-gates only when it widens under `SizingBasis.ActualStop` (the one enforced layer measured at the working stop). Moving it onto the safety stop (removing it) is out of scope.

referencePrice.description: The caller's current market reference the fat-finger band re-measures a new entry against (R-16) — required when decimal? ModifyWorkingOrderRequest.EntryPrice is present. Caller-supplied, as on every order path (the server fetches no venue quote), so it is the client's freshness, not the venue's. A move that does not touch the entry (a working-stop re-stage or a pure resize) does not need it.

size.description: The new contract quantity, or `null` to leave it (gh#292). A resize re-gates at the new size and modifies the order in place at the venue, transmitting the gate-approved quantity (a downsize the gate binds is honoured, never silently exceeded). The always-native safety bracket carries no size of its own — the gateway attaches it on fill, sized to the realized fill — so a resize leaves the eventual fill protected by construction (verified on practice before live, gh#293). `<= 0` is refused; the order must be `Working` (a partially-filled order is refused, closing the only stale-bracket-size window).

ModifyWorkingOrderRequest.description: The request to modify a working order in place — a PATCH that moves the resting entry at the venue (gh#259), re-stages the hidden working stop (gh#267), moves both together (gh#278), and/or resizes the order (gh#292). At least one of decimal? ModifyWorkingOrderRequest.EntryPrice / decimal? ModifyWorkingOrderRequest.WorkingStopPrice / int? ModifyWorkingOrderRequest.Size must be present (a int? ModifyWorkingOrderRequest.Size equal to the order's current size is a no-op). The safety stop stays invariant on every path, so the R-5 catastrophic floor is untouched; the full chain `safety → working → entry` is re-validated before the venue is touched.

dedupKey.description: The rated item's dedup key (its NewsRecord primary key).

NewsFeedbackRequest.description: A star/mute request on a news item (gh#27). The dedup key rides in the body — it is a URL, not path-safe.

NotificationSeverity.description: How loudly a notification should arrive (gh#243, ADR-0019's P1/P2/P3 taxonomy).

OrderSide.description: Which way an order goes. Venue wire values differ (ProjectX sends 0 bid / 1 ask); adapters map.

OrderType.description:
The venue-neutral order types. Deliberately the common set — venue-specific extras (ProjectX
`JoinBid`/`JoinAsk`) stay out of the core, and types not every venue offers are gated by
VenueCapability rather than assumed (R-17).

hysteresis.description: A new re-arm dead-band; must be positive when set (clearing it is not offered here).

oneOf.description: A new comparison; Unknown is refused.

PatchTriggerRequest.description:
The body of a patch-trigger request (gh#385). Every field is optional — null means "leave unchanged". The
debounce state (`ArmState`, `ArmCycle`, `LastFiredAt`, `LastEvaluatedValue`) is deliberately
absent: it is the scan's and the journal's, never the caller's, and any edit re-seeds the arm state silently.

credentialKey.description: The new credential key this connection should name.

RotateCredentialsRequest.description: Rotate which credential key a connection names (gh#210, ADR-0015).

pointValue.description: The instrument's point value (currency per point per contract).

quantity.description: The contracts asked for — the gate decides what is actually authorized.

safetyStop.description: The safety-stop price — the deterministic worst case (R-5).

referencePrice.description: The current reference price the fat-finger band measures from.

type.description: How the order rests. Trailing stops are refused (no trail distance on the ticket).

target.description: The optional take-profit price (ADR-0007, gh#173) — the profit side of a native OCO bracket. It must sit on the winning side of Entry (above for a long, below for a short); a wrong-side target is refused before the gate. `null` means no profit leg (the two-leg bracket).

SendOrderRequest.description:
The request to send one order through the gate (gh#11). The instrument's tick size and point value ride the
request because no Instrument entity exists yet (recorded on the dictionary §1 row) — the caller supplies
the spec the risk math needs.

stage.description: The declared stage. `Unknown` is refused — clearing the override says that.

SetStageOverrideRequest.description: The request to declare an account's stage, overriding the conservative name-resolver (gh#76).

SizingBasis.description: Which stop the per-trade risk budget is divided by when sizing (configurable, R-5 / ADR-0007).

SoftSignalKind.description: The kind of per-user feedback on a soft-signal / news item (gh#27, ADR-0014). A refusable zero: SoftSignalKind.Unknown is never a real kind — feedback must declare its intent — refused at construction and by a DB check. One entity (`SoftSignalFeedback`) unifies all kinds; star and mute ship now, and the 👍/👎 sentiment (direction) axis is deferred (R-2) and will extend this enum without reshaping the store.

stage.description: The stage being classified. Never AccountStage.Unknown.

capitalAtRisk.description: `true` if capital is at risk at this stage (maps to Live).

StageConventionDto.description: One stage declaration — what a stage means at a firm (gh#60).

SuggestionPassReason.description: Why the operator passed a Suggestion — the canonical eight reasons settled by gh#539, taken from the operator-validated pass sheet in the wireframes. A multi-select, so it is a `[Flags]` value stored in one integer and sliced by R-9 with a bitwise test.

reasons.description:
The pass reasons, a `[Flags]` multi-select. SuggestionPassReason.None (the default) is a valid,
neutral pass.

note.description: An optional free-text note, capped at int SuggestionDisposition.NoteMaxLength.

SuggestionPassRequest.description: The body of a pass (gh#547, R-4). Both fields are optional: a pass is a neutral decline, not a rejection, so the operator need give no reason at all.

referencePrice.description: The caller's current market price, as on every order path (the server fetches no venue quote). It does double duty: the take-time drift re-check re-measures it against the suggestion's entry tolerance now (R-12, not the eventually-consistent SuggestionState.Stale flag), and it is the fat-finger band's reference once the ticket reaches the gate (R-16). Must be positive.

SuggestionTakeRequest.description: The body of a take (gh#548, R-11b / R-12). Its only field is the current market reference — the two numbers a server-originated proposal cannot invent (the tick size, point value and safety-stop distance) come from the instrument-spec source, never the client (that is ruled out in writing on SendOrderRequest).

instrument.description: The traded instrument it maps to (e.g. `ES`).

keywords.description: The keywords that mark the topic matched.

instrument.description: The instrument for an instrument-scoped topic; ignored for a global one.

TopicRequest.description: A topic create / edit request (gh#359). PATCH replaces the topic whole.

TopicScope.description: A topic's reach (gh#359). A refusable zero: TopicScope.Unknown never matches — a topic must declare whether it is instrument-scoped or global, so an unset scope can't silently attach news to an instrument. Refused at construction and by a DB check.

TrailingMode.description: How an account's trailing drawdown floor moves. A property of the account, not the firm — Apex sells both kinds, so it is keyed off the account.

TriggerRoute.description: Where a trigger fire routes (ADR-0008) — the two outcomes a trigger definition chooses between.

Bearer.description: JWT issued by POST /auth/login, sent as: Authorization: Bearer {token}.
